Connect the Dots

Study the dots, hide their numbers, and connect the pattern from memory.

0 / 12 dotsNext 10 pointsMistakes 0 / 3Puzzle 1

Study the numbers, then start the challenge.

How to play

  1. Study where the twelve numbered dots sit, then choose Hide numbers & start. The numbers disappear until the round ends.
  2. Connect dots 1 through 12 from memory. Each correct choice draws a line and earns 10 points.
  3. A wrong choice costs 5 points. Three mistakes end the round. A hint outlines the next dot but costs 10 points. Start again shows the numbers and gives you a fresh attempt.
  4. Next puzzle cycles through three different patterns. Each completed pattern can score up to 120 points.
